name: codex-diagram
description: Create, inspect and edit Mermaid diagrams beside Codex conversations.

interface.shortDescription: Live diagrams beside your Codex conversation
interface.longDescription: Keep a live Diagram panel beside the current Codex conversation. Diagram follows the graph Codex reads, creates or updates in that thread, while the global Diagram library remains available for browsing, CRUD, export and full-screen editing. Supports Mermaid structured diagrams and version-controlled freeform Canvas documents.
defaultPrompt: @Diagram show the diagrams in this workspace.
